notes.title: Announcement of Version 1.9 Update for Metal Slug: Awakening
notes.content: [p]Dear Commander,[/p][p]Mech Troops Rise! Rally at Ice Pole! Brand new version, with a plethora of exciting content waiting for you to explore![/p][p]We are scheduled for a maintenance update from 14:00 to 20:00 (UTC - 5) on June 9th. Once the update is complete, you will receive New Version Invitation *1 (redeemable only once for Sapphires *500) when logging into the game.[/p][p]Gameplay Updates and Optimizations[/p][p]1. New Gameplay: Phantasmic Geocenter[/p][p]Brand-new PVE gameplay, vast map, and a thrilling mowing experience! In the Phantasmic Geocenter gameplay, you can:[/p][p]- Carry the brand - new combat unit - Source Energy Mech, explore in randomly generated large - scale map levels, enjoy exciting battles, eliminate enemy soldiers to accumulate energy, and defeat the final boss.[/p][p]- Obtain generous rewards: Legendary - quality Laser Gun, Mythic Weapon Fragments, Season - exclusive Solution Chip, and a large number of other rewards.[/p][p]2. New Joint Operation - Abyss[/p][p]- New mechanism levels "Slate Sealing Spirit" and "Melting Ice" are officially available.[/p][p]- Gameplay Reward Upgrade: In the Joint Operation - Abyss gameplay, the ranking rewards in the Abyss Polar Mode have been upgraded to selectable fragments of classic legendary weapons.[/p][p]- Friendly reminder: After the S4 version update, Double Empowerment Cards will be recycled along with other S3 Season items. Each Double Empowerment Card will be refunded with 88 Rubies.[/p][p]3. New Core[/p][p]- Tetsuyuki Core 4-piece Set: After causing explosive damage, your own damage is increased.[/p][p]Mars Root Core 4-Piece Set: After causing damage at close range, your own damage is increased.[/p][p]- Raging Science Core 4-Piece Set: After causing damage at far distance range, your own damage is increased.[/p][p]- Missile Library Core 4-Piece Set: When hitting or killing multiple enemy units, gain an attack power boost and generate bombs.[/p][p]4. New Main Story: New adventure, set off immediately[/p][p]New Adventure Stages Unlocked: Robotic Soldiers Emerge, Journey to the Ice Pinnacle. Unleash the Crisis of the Ice Source and Fight for Survival![/p][p]5. Update about Arcade Carnival[/p][p] - Wrecking Yard/Core Express/Djinn of Wealth unlocks new area Parking No. 8/Station/Altar[/p][p] - The Raid Voucher drop rate for Maze Challenge has been adjusted: Now you can claim 1 voucher for every 2 completions.[/p][p]6. Stage rewards raised[/p][p]The first-clearance rewards of coins and Military Card for S4 World Adventure levels have been raised.[/p][p]7. Season Benefits[/p][p]- After the new season starts, commanders can complete mission challenges in the Season Kick-off event mission[/p][p] to obtain the legendary quality Laser Gun - Sunwheel Scale and a large number of rewards.[/p][p]- The Season Kick-off event lasts for 30 days and contains 7 mission challenges. One mission challenge will be unlocked each day after the season starts.[/p][p]8. Other Optimizations & Updates:​​[/p][p]- Reduced​ the Sapphire cost for ​Resource Recovery​ in select game modes.[/p][p]- Adjusted​ monster difficulty in ​Hot Pursuit​ (now easier).[/p][p]- Research Workshop​ level cap increased to ​1000.[/p][p]- Weapon Display Stand: 4th slot unlocked when Commanders reach ​Lv. 150.[/p][p]- Season Mark – Hall of Glory added ​​a new Regular Display.[/p][p]New Resource[/p][p]1. \[Brand-new Rare Character- Freyja, June 10th - June 16th][/p][p]The energetic girl "Freyja" will appear in the character special dig on June 10th. Let's embrace the baptism of the cat punch![/p][p]2. \[Brand-new Rare Character- Mai Shiranui, June 10th - June 16th][/p][p]Collaboration Character Mai Shiranui Debuts! Starting from June 10th, you can obtain this hero through the character special dig and the Active Event "Feast of Butterflies".[/p][p]3. \[The brand-new weapon Plasma Cannon, June 10th - June 16th][/p][p]The brand-new weapon with severe injury abnormal attributes - Plasma Cannon will be available in the Weapon Special on June 10th. Let's look forward to the explosive damage it brings![/p][p]4. New Combat Unit Source Energy Mech[/p][p]Robotic Soldiers Emerge to Reinforce the Battlefield! Experience Season 4's All-New Combat with the Energy Core Mech![/p][p]- The Source Energy Mech will provide 2 style abilities, each of which has a basic support skill and a powerful summoning skill.[/p][p]- The Source Energy Mech has a rich Solution Chip Transformation Function. Collecting different solution chips in Season 4 can strengthen the abilities of different styles of the Source Energy Mech.[/p][p]New Event[/p][p]1. "Feast of Butterflies" from June 10th to June 30th[/p][p]Commanders can claim the powerful character Mai Shiranui for free in the event exchange store, along with special items such as the Alloy Pickaxes and Sapphires.[/p][p]2. New weapon "Power Plasma Cannon" from June 10th to June 26th[/p][p]In the new season, there is a new mechanism firearm Charging Plasma Cannon. Get it for free by participating in the event![/p][p]3. "New Season Sign-in" from June 8th to June 30th[/p][p]Sign-in for 7 days to get gifts[/p][p]Log in to the game for Father's Day on June 15th, to get special gifts.[/p][p]4. New Challenge Phantasmic Geocenter from June 10th to June 30th[/p][p]During the event, participating in the new gameplay "Phantasmic Geocenter" gives you a chance to obtain gameplay - exclusive resources to help you clear the stage.[/p][p]5. Shiranui Performance, from June 10th to June 30th[/p][p]During the event, completing the specified tasks will allow you to obtain exclusive accessories for Mai Shiranui and a high quality core.[/p][p]6. Support Pass Update - Tactical Maid launches on June 16th[/p][p]The limited outfit "Tactical Maid" is newly added to the Support Pass. You can obtain it by upgrading to the max level![/p][p]7. New Airdrop Card launches on June 10th[/p][p]Purchase the Airdrop Card to unlock the exclusive buff for the new season gameplay - Phantasmic Geocenter, helping you enjoy a smooth gaming experience.[/p][p]8. Awakening of the Mech - Crimson Steel Warhammer: Niel launches on June 21st[/p][p]Starting from June 21st, commanders can use Wish Vouchers to draw in the store. Purchase the Mech Awakening, and obtain the corresponding vehicle for free in subsequent versions.[/p]

- Obtain generous rewards: Legendary - quality Laser Gun, Mythic Weapon Fragments, Season - exclusive Solution Chip, and a large number of other rewards.
- New mechanism levels "Slate Sealing Spirit" and "Melting Ice" are officially available.
- New Core

- Mars Root Core 4-Piece Set: After causing damage at close range, your own damage is increased.
- Raging Science Core 4-Piece Set: After causing damage at far distance range, your own damage is increased.
- Missile Library Core 4-Piece Set: When hitting or killing multiple enemy units, gain an attack power boost and generate bombs.
- New Adventure Stages Unlocked: Robotic Soldiers Emerge, Journey to the Ice Pinnacle. Unleash the Crisis of the Ice Source and Fight for Survival!
- Wrecking Yard/Core Express/Djinn of Wealth unlocks new area Parking No. 8/Station/Altar

The energetic girl "Freyja" will appear in the character special dig on June 10th. Let's embrace the baptism of the cat punch!
Collaboration Character Mai Shiranui Debuts! Starting from June 10th, you can obtain this hero through the character special dig and the Active Event "Feast of Butterflies".
The brand-new weapon with severe injury abnormal attributes - Plasma Cannon will be available in the Weapon Special on June 10th. Let's look forward to the explosive damage it brings!
Robotic Soldiers Emerge to Reinforce the Battlefield! Experience Season 4's All-New Combat with the Energy Core Mech!
- The Source Energy Mech will provide 2 style abilities, each of which has a basic support skill and a powerful summoning skill.
- The Source Energy Mech has a rich Solution Chip Transformation Function. Collecting different solution chips in Season 4 can strengthen the abilities of different styles of the Source Energy Mech.
Commanders can claim the powerful character Mai Shiranui for free in the event exchange store, along with special items such as the Alloy Pickaxes and Sapphires.
In the new season, there is a new mechanism firearm Charging Plasma Cannon. Get it for free by participating in the event!
Sign-in for 7 days to get gifts
Log in to the game for Father's Day on June 15th, to get special gifts.
During the event, participating in the new gameplay "Phantasmic Geocenter" gives you a chance to obtain gameplay - exclusive resources to help you clear the stage.
During the event, completing the specified tasks will allow you to obtain exclusive accessories for Mai Shiranui and a high quality core.
The limited outfit "Tactical Maid" is newly added to the Support Pass. You can obtain it by upgrading to the max level!
Purchase the Airdrop Card to unlock the exclusive buff for the new season gameplay - Phantasmic Geocenter, helping you enjoy a smooth gaming experience.
Starting from June 21st, commanders can use Wish Vouchers to draw in the store. Purchase the Mech Awakening, and obtain the corresponding vehicle for free in subsequent versions.

notes.title: Metal Slug: Awakening Update Announcement
notes.content:
Dear Commander,

"Soaring Skies, Thunderous Changes" The new version arrives with exciting features and gameplay, ready for you to challenge!
We are scheduled for a maintenance update on 2024.02.10 14:00 - 20:00 (UTC-5). Once the update is complete, you will receive New Version Invitation *1 (redeemable only once for Sapphires *500) when logging into the game. 
In the new S3 season, commanders will be able to experience updated gameplay and explore the Sky City alongside Ame, the princess of a mysterious kingdom! What exactly does this update have in store? Join Rumi to find out!

New Gameplay
[New Abyssal Rift]
Time: 2025.02.11
1. New map "Sky City" - The Floating Riftland
2. New Season Skill unlocked - Atmospheric Barrier. Employ the barrier to face the new "climate attacks" challenges, granting your squad substantial buffs. As you encounter different harsh weather conditions in each zone, remember to use the "Atmospheric Barrier" for effective defense!

[Master Weapon Fragment Exchange]
Time: 2025.02.11
The weapon system in the S3 season introduces a new exchange feature. You can access the Weapon Star Up-Exchange interface to trade Master Weapon Fragments of the corresponding quality for existing weapon fragments to facilitate weapon star upgrades. Tip: The S3 Season Store will offer some Master Weapon Fragments for commanders to exchange.

[New Joint Operation - Abyss]
Time: 2025.02.11
In the S3 season's Joint Operation - Abyss gameplay, commanders will venture to the Sky City, soaring high above the earth, to begin a brand-new adventure! The island's protective barrier has shattered, resulting in frequent extreme weather. 
Commanders can utilize the Empyreal Wings to absorb the meteorological energy from the extreme weather, charging up weather machinery to destroy enemy battleships and fortresses.

[Abyssal Cruise]
Time: 2025.02.17
1. Two new companions are on board, each bringing a new Expertise Style!  
2. Encounter new enemies, mechanics, and stages for a fresh set of challenges;  
3. Daily quiz added—correct answers provide all-day buffs.

[New Core Parts]
Time: 2025.02.11
S3 Season introduces new Core Parts - equip them to explore endless possibilities:
- Gaea Tower Core
Ideal for characters with WOUND weapons, offering maximum DMG bonuses when using character skills. Repeated skill use can refresh the buff duration.
- Dybbuk Manifestation Core
Suited for characters with WEAK weapons, granting a Summons DMG bonus with each summon generated, enabling summons to deal significant damage.
- Amadeus Core
Perfect for characters with FREEZE weapons. To maximize benefits, commanders need to focus on increasing CRIT rate to quickly gain the Core's advantages.
- Unyielding Warrior Core
Best for characters with IGNITE weapons, where flexible movement or aerial combat abilities will maximize this Core's potential.

[Joyful Treasure Basin]
Time: 2025.02.11
Treasure Basin, grab ingots! The "Treasure Basin" event is now open. Join the challenges during this period and collect ingots for a chance to receive Powerball Fragments, Epic Gears, Limited Titles, Alloy Pickaxes, Ruby Pickaxes, Legendary Weapon Fragments, and other exciting prizes.

[Season Settlement and Reward Exchange]
1. Season Settlement: With the season update, it's time for reward settlement! Based on your performance in the S2 season, rewards for Season Mark and The Merit Leaderboard will be settled, and your Abyss Score will be converted into Abyss Coins. Log in to the game to claim your S2 season settlement rewards.
2. Season Exchange: The S2 season Ultimate Exchange is open for a limited time. Use your Abyss Coins to exchange for items, including character-exclusive Gem Rewards, Mythic Weapon Fallen Star Fragments, and other ultra-rare items.

[Growth Acceleration]
With the start of the new season, lower-level commanders will experience accelerated growth:
1. Earn additional resources when participating in activities that provide item resources.
2. Icons of item resources with growth acceleration will have an acceleration mark; click them to view the current acceleration rate.


[Level Boost]
Time: 2025.02.11
Concerned about lagging behind due to your current level? Don't worry! The S3 season presents a new growth system that lets you "instantly boost your level to quickly catch up with the main pack"! Kick off the season perfectly and easily tackle the new space adventure challenges!
1. When the server's highest level is 130, players below level 122 will be boosted to level 122.
2. When the server's highest level is 125, players below level 117 will be boosted to level 117.


[Warzone Regroup]
Time: 2025.02.11
The new S3 season, Warzone Regroup, is coming soon! We aim to enhance the competitive gaming experience for commanders in the new season by grouping several servers into a single warzone based on criteria such as commanders' combat power, server launch dates, and active player counts. For more details, please check the official community content.

New Content
[New Character - Ame]
New Rare Quality in S3 Season
Time: 2025.02.11 - 2025.02.17
Available from: Character Special Treasure Dig
Princess of the Armer Kingdom, the queen of aerial combat! The first character with flight capabilities, gaining a shield and immunity to most control effects while flying. Fire in tandem with weapons and unleash area bombardments after charging.

[New Weapon - Chakram Launcher]
Time: 2025.02.11 - 2025.02.17
Available from: Weapon Special, Weapon Treasure Dig
Using blades as tongues of fire, the infinite chakrams dominate the battlefield. This weapon represents the perfect fusion of cold and hot weaponry, utilizing a modern firearm propulsion system to launch circular blades. The high-temperature blades cause deep burns that are hard to heal.

[New Character - Alessio Limited-time UP]
Time: 2025.02.14 - 2025.02.20
Alessio, once a nobody from the outer city of Navenia, unexpectedly accepted a mission from the legendary "Captain Red Hawk" in a moment of crisis. Donning a mask, he became a hero. A hero should be seen and respected by the world!

[Lilith’s New Outfit - Fish Dragon Dance]
Time: 2025.02.18 - 2025.02.24
Available from: Djinn Wish
As an inheritor of the "Fenghua Dragon Cloth" intangible cultural heritage, her overall attire reflects the unique charm of the dragon dance culture.

[New Vehicle - Raynor]
Time: 2025.02.22 - 2025.03.01
Available from: Blind Box
The new vehicle, Towering Raynor, is coming soon. The powerful Towering Raynor is sure to help commanders overtake competitors on sharp turns and support your Metal Slug adventure!

New Events
Repair Navenia to Get Alessio
Time: 2025.02.09 - 2025.02.26
Commanders are tasked with helping Alessio complete repair missions. By completing missions like the Alessio Trial Stage and watching Alessio's video, you can earn Repair Points. These points can be exchanged for Alessio's Token *50, as well as a variety of valuable in-game rewards!

Rare Weapon - Flameborne Chainblade Rifle available for FREE
Time: 2025.02.11 - 2025.02.26
Log in cumulatively to receive fantastic rewards such as the new version's weapon - Rare quality Flameborne Chainblade Rifle Fragments (which can be exchanged for a complete rare quality Chainblade Rifle), and Maze Raid Vouchers.

Chocolate Battle
Time:  2025.02.11 - 2025.02.26
Commanders can obtain chocolates by completing the stages. These chocolates can be used in a gacha for a chance to win Scarlett's Token, Sapphires, Raid Vouchers, and other generous rewards!

Joyful Treasure Basin
Time: 2025.02.11 - 2025.02.17
Participate the event to earn exciting rewards like Sapphire Surprise Bags and Legendary Coupons. Don't wait—begin your Treasure Hoard challenge now!

Get Snow Prep Field for FREE
Time: 2025.02.15 - 2025.02.26
With spring plum blossoms stirring and chilly frosty nights behind us, a new preparation field is arriving to support commanders on their adventures in the new year! Join the event and light up Snowflakes to obtain the Snow Prep Field!

notes.title: Welcome to the New Year - Early January Event Preview
notes.content:
Metal Slug Mission Start!

With the arrival of 2025, there will be new events in Metal Slug! Let's take a look at the events for the first half of January!

1. Everyone's Fission Gun
▶ Event Duration: December 30th - January 9th (server time)
▶ Details:Participate in the event and complete the daily tasks to get the exchange props. These can be used to exchange for Military Card IV, General Core Parts and other powerful props, and more Devour Fission Gun waiting for you to get!

2. Spec-Ops Rare Character - Lilith
▶ Event Duration: Opened on January 1st, 2025 (server time)
▶ Details: During the event, the new character Lilith will be introduced in Metal Slug, Commanders who have an affinity for her, don't let this opportunity pass!

3. New Weapon - Underworld Gaze
▶ Event Duration: Opened on January 1st, 2025 (server time)
▶ Details: During the event, the new weapon [Underworld Gaze] will make its debut in Metal Slug, players will have a chance to get this limited weapon by digging treasure!

4. New Weapon - Radiance Fission Gun
▶ Event Duration: Opened on January 1st, 2025 (server time)
▶ Details: During the event, the new weapon [Radiance Fission Gun] will make its debut in Metal Slug! Epic Fission Gun, high-tech with antique craftsmanship, is a valuable work of art and an invincible weapon of victory!

5. New Weapons - Devour Fission Gun
▶ Event Duration: Opened on January 1st, 2025 (server time)
▶ Details: During the event, the new weapon [Devour Fission Gun] will make its debut in Metal Slug! notes.title: Metal Slug: Awakening December Events Preview
notes.content:
Metal Slug Mission Start!

Hey commanders, get ready for a ton of upcoming events! Take a look at this event guide for a preview of what's to come!
 
1. The Debut of the New Character Joe and His Skin
Date: December 2nd - December 8th (server time) 
Details: During the event, your chances of obtaining Joe from Character Dig will significantly increase. There is also a chance to obtain Joe's Rare skin - Darkwing Guardian in Djinn Wish!
2. Explore the Shoreless Sea - Abyssal Cruise
Date: December 2nd 5:00- December 29th 23:59(server time)
Details: The map consists of multiple islands, each with two different routes set up. Commanders will need to assemble two different squads to clear each route to unlock the next chapter.
*Abyss Score will determine commanders' base attributes, and attributes such as the levels of characters, weapons, vehicles and cores will also be partially applied in matches.*

3. Weapon Awakening
Date: December 3rd - December 9th (server time)
Details: Commanders can awaken the three Laser Guns in Djinn Wish: Hunter Heritage, Sunwheel Scale, and Cold Nebula.
 
4. Star-Picking Miner
Date: December 8th 5:00 - December 21st 4:59 (server time)
Details: Commanders have the chance to win rich rewards such as [Alloy Pickaxes, Sapphires] by using the [Star Lock] items obtained from completing corresponding tasks in the event.

notes.title: Metal Slug: Awakening Update Announcement
notes.content:
Metal Slug Mission Start!

Dear commanders, we will be carrying out a server maintenance on October 21st at 14:00-20:00 (UTC-5). During this period, the server will be temporarily closed. In order to ensure that the gaming experience of all commanders is not affected, please make  preparations in advance to avoid any unnecessary losses.
After the maintenance is completed, we will offer compensation to each commander including 500 Sapphires, 88,888 coins, and 50 Military Card IV.

Below are the detailed contents of this update, please read carefully.

1. New Gameplay - Treasure Cave: In this season's Abyssal Rift, commanders will venture into a new rift zone where the ocean and land coexist. In this dangerous yet treasure-filled area, embark on a new journey alongside your clubmates!
2. Gameplay Upgrade - Joint Operation Abyss Mode: In the new season of Joint Operation - Abyss Mode, commanders will head to the newly introduced Morden Army Base. The Curse Demon has taken control of Morden Army's soldiers and armor, and the curse is spreading rapidly. Unlock new mysterious powers to help break the curse and defeat your enemies.
3. New System - Growth Boosting: Growth Boosting allows commanders who are falling behind to earn more development resources by participating in daily gameplays. Additionally, level boosts are available to help those lagging behind catch up to the average level of the main group.
4. New Weapon - Laser Gun: Combining stable firepower with the potential for an energy explosion, the Laser Gun is the epitome of destructive force. High-pressure pulses surge within the energy core, the gun is always ready to wreak havoc!
5. New Character - Eiserner: Although Eiserner was just an ordinary girl with no military training not long ago, her remarkable strategic abilities quickly elevated her to become Blackfire's youngest senior commander. Striving for victory with "minimal cost," Eiserner gives the command: Attack!

notes.title: Metal Slug: Awakening Season Settlement Info
notes.content:
Metal Slug Mission Start!

While waiting for the start of the new season, let's address the Season Settlement questions that everyone is concerned about. Let's take a look together!

1. Elevate Ultimate Level
First and foremost, we want to remind all commanders that upon reaching Level 110 during the season update, any unspent stamina and resources will be settled!If you prefer not to be settled, make good use of these resources and sprint towards the ultimate level!

Upon reaching Level 110, commanders will unlock the ultimate level, where all earned experience thereafter will be converted into ultimate level experience. 
By continuously improving the ultimate level, commanders can claim generous rewards in the "Level Rewards" section of the ultimate talent interface. 
With the increase in ultimate level, commanders will also receive ultimate talent points to unlock special talent features, enhancing your abilities in various gameplay modes and even unlocking some new gameplay content. 

Furthermore, we want to remind everyone that, with the launch of the ultimate talent in the new season, all talents, effects, and ultimate level will reset. However, there's no need to worry because after the season settlement, when it is time to reap the rewards, plenty of rewards will be waiting for everyone to redeem!

2. Season Settlement 
During the settlement process, the Seasonal Treasures will be temporarily open. The Merit Badge accumulated in Season 1 can be used to exchange for limited gems, character tokens, alloy pickaxes, weapon fragments, and many other items!
Merit Badge mainly come from the Abyss Value settlement at the end of the season. Commanders can make a final push to increase Abyss Value, allowing you to redeem more generous rewards when the Seasonal Treasures opens.
Additionally, if commanders who reach Level 110 at the season update have unspent resources, these resources will be settled and converted into item rewards.

The specific resources involved in the season update settlement are as follows:

1. Remaining stamina, turkey drumsticks, and stamina purchase times
2. Resource retrieval rewards for the first three days before the new season starts
3. First-clear rewards for any incomplete World Adventure stages
4. First-clear rewards for any incomplete Crystal Mine Exploration stages.

Commanders, hurry and check if you have any resources that will be settled!

If there are unspent resources when the new season starts, there is no need to worry. All remaining stamina & resources (excluding purchased stamina) will be settled and converted into item rewards based on a certain ratio. 
The specific settlement rules are as follows:

1. Stamina: Only stamina exceeding the stamina limit will be settled and converted into rewards. For example, if a commander has 300/180 stamina, a maximum of 300-180 = 120 stamina will be settled

2. Turkey Drumsticks: All turkey drumsticks will be settled and converted into a specific reward.

3. Stamina Purchases: All current stamina purchase times will be settled and will not be converted into rewards.

4. Resource retrieval: For the first three days before the new season starts, all stamina & resources that can be retrieved through the resource retrieval feature will be settled and converted into specific rewards.

5. World Adventure: All incomplete World Adventure stages (including Story, Hard mode, and Flashback mode) will have their first-clear rewards settled, where experience and energy will be converted into rewards. The settled World Adventure levels will be marked as completed, and resources other than experience and stamina from the first-clear rewards will be sent to the commander via email when the new season starts.

6. Arcade Carnival - Crystal Mine Exploration: All incomplete Arcade Carnival -Crystal Mine Exploration stages will have their first-clear rewards settled, where experience will be converted into rewards. The settled Arcade Carnival - Crystal Mine Exploration stages will be marked as completed, and resources other than experience from the first-clear rewards will be sent to the commander via email when the new season starts.

3. Growth Acceleration
Opening Time: After the new update on October 22nd (server time)
System Overview: At the start of the new season, commanders whose levels are lower relatively will enjoy Growth Acceleration, including level boosts, increase DMG to the team's weapons, the level of team's core upgrades, Display Stand developmental materials distribution, and Vehicle Research Workshop level upgrades. 

System Rewards: By participating in the corresponding daily gameplay, commanders can obtain more military cards, coins, general core part, gear oill, experience points, and conversion parts. 

Friendly Reminder: The distribution of level boosts and developmental resources will consider the cultivation status of all the commander's weapons, cores, display stand, as well as the total amount of developmental materials in the inventory. There will be no excessive/duplicate distributions.

notes.title: Metal Slug: Awakening Abyss Rift New Season
notes.content:
Metal Slug Mission Start!

Commanders, the second season of the  Abyss Rift is coming soon. You can embark on new adventures in the Rift Ground, where danger and fortune await. 
Start a new journey with your Club partners in this fresh area!

The following below are the updates for this new season, please read them carefully, commanders!

1. Season Settlement and Season Exchange
Season Settlement: After the season update, Commanders will receive Merit Badges based on their performance in Season 1, as well as rewards from The Merit Leaderboard rankings and Abyss Score , which can be collected in-game to receive them.

Season Exchange: The Season 1 exchange is temporarily opened, Commanders can use Merit Badges to exchange for items, including  Rare Character Fragments, Character Exclusive Gem Reward,Mythic Weapon Fragment, and other rare items.

2. New Season Journey
A new round of the season journey has begun, Commanders can check in-game to preview the new season content in advance!

3. New Abyss Rift
A new map is about to open, with a significantly increased territorial size, thus Commanders no longer have to worry about insufficient land blocks.
There will be an added new season skill "Power of Clear Current". Inflict Power of Clear Current on Weapons. When shooting, it will unleash Clear Current and break Curses.
The Abyss Rift introduces a new gameplay "Treasure Cave." Commanders will accumulate exploration progress in the treasure cave while occupying territory. Discover and challenge the treasure cave to win rich rewards!
New underwater levels have been added, designed for free movement underwater, providing a whole new combat experience.

4. New Joint Operation - Abyss
In the new season's joint operation - Abyss gameplay, Commanders will arrive at the brand-new Morden Army base. Cursed Demons have taken control of the soldiers and armor of the Morden Army. It is up to you to help prevent the curse from spreading rapidly.

Face the challenge, win generous rewards and Tidal Essences! Strengthen Tidal Heart, unlock new mysterious powers, break the curse, and defeat the enemies.

5. New World Adventure
Hidden dangers and opportunities await in the new area: Atlan!
